research_notes: The eventual cross-profile matrix need not test every target on every profile; representative replication near the candidate boundary is sufficient for practical generalization.
Coarse ascent can remain on W3 to locate the region efficiently.
Then reasoning-heavy and I/O-heavy profiles can test near the candidate cap/boundary.
This balances evidence quality with automation budget.
If a secondary profile fails materially lower, refinement should account for it.
